description: Look up California unclaimed property by owner name, optionally narrowed by city, ZIP code, or minimum balance. Covers property reported at $500 and up. Returns up to 100 matches with dated source details and the free official claim link.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return; defaults to 20 and cannot exceed 100.

zip.description: Optional 5-digit or ZIP+4 owner ZIP code.

name: unclaimed_property_lookup
title: Look Up California Unclaimed Property
